title: Anthropic native SSE termination and accounting
pins: Native ordered public event traces, terminal classification, accounting completeness and partial tool-call safety through the same owned SSE bytes in PHP, TypeScript and Python.
scope: Anthropic text, maxSteps(1), raw byte/UTF-8/SSE chunk boundaries. No inference, network, tool execution, private billing metadata or multi-turn coverage.

discrimination.note: Twenty actual native source defects (ten per port: EOF-as-stop, start-only final usage, absent usage as zero, erased Error, dropped partial text, omitted/duplicate terminal end, broken incremental UTF8, Unknown instead of Error finish and unclosed text) each fail the intended independent property; every byte-restored ten-case control passes. Raw trace divergence remains explicitly G-125.

findings: G-115 semantic properties are required in every language. G-125 separately records native stream event vocabulary, payload shape and finish-literal divergence; raw traces are retained without hiding step events or reshaping payloads.
